mapper.insert: insert into wl_document(category_id, title, summary, tags, cover_url, uploader_name, file_format, file_size, page_count, point_price, preview_pages, original_object_key, full_object_key, preview_object_key, conversion_status, publish_status, publish_time, view_count, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark) values(#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{tags}, #{coverUrl}, #{uploaderName}, #{fileFormat}, #{fileSize}, #{pageCount}, #{pointPrice}, #{previewPages}, #{originalObjectKey}, #{fullObjectKey}, #{previewObjectKey}, #{conversionStatus}, #{publishStatus}, null, #{viewCount}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0', #{remark})
mapper.update: update wl_document set category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, tags = #{tags}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, point_price = #{pointPrice}, preview_pages = #{previewPages}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and publish_status = 'DRAFT' and del_flag = '0'

update wl_document set publish_status = #{publishStatus}, publish_time = case when #{publishStatus} = 'PUBLISHED' then now() else null end, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and publish_status != #{publishStatus}

update wl_document set original_object_key = #{originalObjectKey}, file_format = coalesce(#{fileFormat}, file_format), file_size = coalesce(#{fileSize}, file_size), full_object_key = null, preview_object_key = null, conversion_status = 'PENDING', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and publish_status = 'DRAFT' and del_flag = '0'

update wl_document set conversion_status = 'CONVERTING', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and publish_status = 'DRAFT' and conversion_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and del_flag = '0'

update wl_document set full_object_key = #{fullObjectKey}, preview_object_key = #{previewObjectKey}, page_count = #{pageCount}, conversion_status = 'SUCCESS', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and publish_status = 'DRAFT' and conversion_status in ('PENDING','CONVERTING','FAILED') and del_flag = '0'
update wl_document set conversion_status = 'FAILED', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and publish_status = 'DRAFT' and conversion_status != 'SUCCESS' and del_flag = '0'
